message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. They likely want to run a command to start Docker. But Docker is a service; you can start it via Docker Desktop or via Docker Engine. On Windows, you can use "docker start" to start a container, not the Docker service. To start Docker service, you might use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service" in PowerShell. Or "docker-machine start default". But the user says "start Docker on window using docker start." That seems ambiguous. They might want to start Docker Desktop. But "docker start" is used to start a container. So maybe they want to start Docker service. We can provide instructions: open PowerShell as admin and run "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service". Or "net start com.docker.service". Or "docker-machine start default". Or "docker start <container>" to start a container.

We can also use the tool to execute a command. The tool is for Windows OS. We can run "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service". Let's choose "net start com.docker.service". We'll use the function to execute that command.
